intent: Collapse B1 and B2 into a single B pool at subcat 1. The M4 clock model has one B (CUR = A1, A2, B, C, N), so two subcategories mapping to one category was indirection with no consumer: it made the depth target unreadable off the subcategory list and would have forced LIBRARY-CONTRACT to carry a 2-to-1 mapping permanently. The 3/11 split encoded nothing -- not rising/falling, not a rotation distinction. Subcat 1 is renamed B; subcat 5 is retired indefinitely, left empty rather than deleted because RadioDJ history and playlist rows may reference it. Order-independent with respect to 2026-08-02-currents-refresh: the two changesets touch disjoint sets of songs in subcat 5.
